name: TMDHosting
tagline: Managed cPanel hosting with LiteSpeed speed and real 24/7 human support
description: TMDHosting is a managed cPanel host known for LiteSpeed-powered speed, unlimited MariaDB databases, and 24/7 human support on WordPress, VPS and shared plans.
about: TMDHosting runs cPanel-based Linux shared, WordPress, VPS and dedicated server hosting out of nine global data centers, alongside Windows/Plesk options. Its WordPress hosting line — Starter, Business and Enterprise — is fully managed and layers free SSL, 1-click staging, and automated backup copies on top of LiteSpeed for faster page loads than stock Apache setups.

WordPress Starter is priced from $9.99/month, Business (the recommended tier, unlimited sites and 100GB SSD) from $13.03/month, and Enterprise (unlimited SSD storage, 4x performance resources) from $19.99/month — all on a triennial (3-year) billing term. Managed VPS hosting starts separately from around $49.99/month.

The intro price only holds for the initial term. Starter renews at $12.49/month, Business at $16.29/month and Enterprise at $24.99/month — roughly a 25% jump — so the real cost to budget for is the renewal rate, not the discounted sign-up price, especially if you don't plan to prepay another multi-year term.
policies: TMDHosting's WordPress and shared hosting plans include a 30-day money-back guarantee, letting new customers request a full refund on hosting fees within their first 30 days if the service isn't a fit. The guarantee excludes domain registrations, add-on services and renewal payments — only the initial hosting term qualifies.
